services.name: The Cabins
services.desc: The museum entrance and Gift Shop is housed in the FRAZIER CABIN. This cabin is an original mid-nineteenth century log cabin which had been erected in Watauga County and later moved to Caldwell County. The Frazier Family, long-time friends of the SAHA, donated it. Tatum Cabin During Filming of Chef Walter Staib's Emmy-award winning show “A Taste of History.” This cabin represents a Longhunter’s Cabin on the North Carolina Frontier in the 18th century. WPA (Work Project Administration) workers built this small cabin in 1935 to use as a bunkhouse while constructing many buildings in Watauga County.
